professional_summary.text: Software Engineer with two years of experience developing backend applications using Python and Django. Skilled in REST API development, SQL databases, Git, Linux, and software engineering best practices. Familiar with Docker and AWS while continuously improving backend development skills.

experience.description: Developed REST APIs using Django REST Framework, designed SQL database schemas, optimized queries, collaborated with frontend developers, wrote unit tests, resolved production bugs, and participated in code reviews.
Assisted in backend development using Python, maintained PostgreSQL databases, used Git for version control, supported Linux server deployments, and fixed application issues.

Inventory Management REST API using Django REST Framework.
Online Appointment Booking System with authentication and SQL database.
